2600: Arjun Ramachandra is an Assistant Professor in the Decision Sciences area at the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore. My research interests broadly lie in optimization under uncertainty at the interface of operations research, probability theory and computer science focusing on leveraging tools from these areas to efficiently solve or derive performance guarantees to complex optimization problems. Specific thrust areas with an interdisciplinary flavour include distributionally robust optimization, data-driven tail risk estimation, theory of negative dependence, correlation gap analysis with weak independence, approximation guarantees with submodularity and derandomization with small sample space constructions. My current research is aimed at analyzing challenging discrete optimization problems to develop novel insights into the behaviour of structured function classes under realistic notions of randomness.

2620: At the valedictory ceremony, Chief Guest Sanjeev Kumar Gupta, CEO, Karnataka Digital Economy Mission (KDEM), delivered an inspiring address celebrating the successful completion of Batch 1 of the programme. Discussing the scale of the FinTech sector, its future, Karnataka government’s schemes, etc., he called Karnataka the FinTech capital of India, and added, “ The IIMBx FinTech programme is more than a learning initiative. It is an investment in the talent that will shape tomorrow's digital economy. Our collaboration with IIMBx and the Government of Karnataka reflects KDEM's commitment to strengthening Karnataka's digital ecosystem through industry-relevant education. To the graduating learners, my message is simple: technology will continue to evolve, but your ability to learn, adapt and innovate will define your journey. The next idea that moves India’s money is sitting in this room.”
